title: FileNotFoundError in path.resolve when uploading an attachment
body:
## Environment

Lattice version 3.0.8; operating system Debian 12; server
region us-east-1.

## Steps

To reproduce:
- With the log window open, start uploading an attachment.
- Use a Windows-style path with backslashes.
- Check the log window; the traceback appears there.

## Expected

Expected uploading an attachment to finish wthout errors.

## Actual

The path in the error mixes slashes and backslashes. The
path was copiied from a Windows machine and contains
backslashes.

## Frequency

Reproduces on about half the runs.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:50 in loop
lattice/ui/upload.py:40 in on_drop
lattice/io/upload.py:118 in send
lattice/io/path.py:234 in resolve
FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'uploads\2026\scan.pdf'
